title: pam-biometrics policy
description: Factors, prompts, and thresholds of the pam-biometrics PAM steps. Layers merge in this order: built-in defaults, defaults, services[service], users[user].defaults, users[user].services[service]. Lists replace, objects merge.

defaults.description: Applies to every service and user.

services.description: Applies to one PAM service. The key is the PAM service name.

users.description: Applies to one user. The key is the user name.

line.description: Text without line breaks or other control characters.

defaults.description: Applies to every service for this user.

services.description: Applies to one PAM service for this user.

layer.description: A partial settings object. A set field replaces the value of the lower layers.

factors.description: The enabled factors. An empty list gives no decision at once.

combine.description: any: one match is sufficient. all: every enabled factor must match.

on_no_decision.description: allow: PAM_IGNORE. deny: treat the attempt as a reject.

timeout_seconds.description: Time that finish waits for a fingerprint or a face after the password, from the start of finish. Without a decision at the end, on_no_decision applies.

password_prompt.description: The first password prompt of start. The default depends on the factors and face.trigger.

wait_message.description: The information line that finish shows when it waits. The default depends on the factors, face.trigger, and timeout_seconds.

max_tries.description: Number of finger scans before a wrong finger rejects the attempt.

match_distance.description: A best distance at or below this value is a match. The resolved value must not be greater than reject_distance.

reject_distance.description: A best distance above this value can reject the attempt.

min_reject_frames.description: A reject needs a face in at least this many frames.

trigger.description: The response to the password prompt of start, or a line typed on a line-mode terminal during the wait of finish, that starts a face scan. The empty text stands for Enter alone.
